# Tools for microbiome analysis {#sec-tool_list}

This appendix lists R tools for microbiome data analysis, in alphabetical
order. Many of them are not based on `TreeSummarizedExperiment`; see
[@sec-convert] for converting data between formats.

::: {.tool-list}

| Tool | Description |
|:-----|:------------|
| [Adaptive gPCA](https://arxiv.org/abs/1702.00501) | A method for structured dimensionality reduction |
| [ALDEx2](https://bioconductor.org/packages/release/bioc/html/ALDEx2.html) | Analysis Of Differential Abundance Taking Sample Variation Into Account |
| [Ampvis2](https://madsalbertsen.github.io/ampvis2/) | Tools for visualising amplicon sequencing data |
| [ANCOM/ANCOM-BC](https://github.com/FrederickHuangLin/ANCOMBC) | R package for Analysis of Composition of Microbiomes (ANCOM-BC) |
| [animalcules](https://compbiomed.github.io/animalcules-docs/) | R shiny app for interactive microbiome analysis |
| [BDMMA](https://academic.oup.com/bioinformatics/article-abstract/35/5/807/5078473) | Batch Effects Correction for Microbiome Data With Dirichlet-multinomial Regression |
| [BEEM](https://github.com/lch14forever/BEEM) | BEEM: Estimating Lotka-Volterra models from time-course microbiome sequencing data |
| [biome-shiny](https://github.com/Biodata-PT/Biome-Shiny) | GUI for microbiome visualization, based on the shiny package "microbiome" |
| [bootLong](https://pratheepaj.github.io/bootLong/) | The Block Bootstrap Method for Longitudinal Microbiome Data |
| [breakaway](https://github.com/search?q=breakaway) | Species Richness Estimation and Modeling |
| [CCREPE](http://bioconductor.org/packages/release/bioc/html/ccrepe.html) | Compositionality Corrected by PErmutation and REnormalization |
| [CoDaSeq](https://github.com/ggloor/CoDaSeq) | Functions for compositional analysis of high throughput sequencing |
| [corncob](https://arxiv.org/abs/1902.02776) | Modeling microbial abundances and dysbiosis with beta-binomial regression |
| [curatedMetagenomicData](https://waldronlab.io/curatedMetagenomicData/) | Accessible, curated metagenomic data through ExperimentHub |
| [dacomp](https://github.com/barakbri/dacomp) | Testing for Differential Abundance in Compositional Counts Data, with Application to Microbiome Studies |
| [DADA2](https://www.nature.com/nmeth/journal/v13/n7/full/nmeth.3869.html) | Divisive Amplicon Denoising Algorithm |
| [DECIPHER](http://www2.decipher.codes/index.html) | Using DECIPHER v2.0 to Analyze Big Biological Sequence Data in R |
| [DECIPHER/IDTAXA](https://doi.org/10.1186/s40168-018-0521-5) | IDTAXA: a novel approach for accurate taxonomic classification of microbiome sequences |
| [decontam](https://microbiomejournal.biomedcentral.com/articles/10.1186/s40168-018-0605-2) | Simple Statistical Identification and Removal of Contaminant Sequences in Marker-Gene and Metagenomics Data |
| [DESeq2](https://www.bioconductor.org/packages/devel/bioc/vignettes/phyloseq/inst/doc/phyloseq-mixture-models.html) | Differential expression analysis for sequence count data |
| [diffTop](https://pratheepaj.github.io/diffTop/) | Differential topic analysis |
| [DivNet](https://github.com/adw96/DivNet) | An R package to estimate diversity when taxa in the community cooccur via a ecological network |
| [DMBC](https://msphere.asm.org/content/2/6/e00536-17) | A Dirichlet-Multinomial Bayes Classifier for Disease Diagnosis With Microbial Compositions |
| [edgeR](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC2796818/) | empirical analysis of DGE in R |
| [GLMMMiRKAT](https://github.com/hk1785/GLMM-MiRKAT) | A distance-based kernel association test based on the generalized linear mixed model |
| [HuMMANet](https://www.biorxiv.org/content/10.64898/2026.08.24.746727v1) | Harmonized cross-study resource of human gut microbiome-metabolome associations |
| [igraph](http://igraph.org/r/) | Network Analysis and Visualization in R |
| [labdsv](https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/labdsv/labdsv.pdf) | Ordination and Multivariate Analysis for Ecology |
| [MaAsLin2](https://github.com/biobakery/Maaslin2) | MaAsLin2: Microbiome Multivariate Association with Linear Models |
| [mare](https://github.com/katrikorpela/mare) | Microbiota Analysis in R Easily |
| [massMap](https://microbiomejournal.biomedcentral.com/articles/10.1186/s40168-018-0517-1) | A Two-Stage Microbial Association Mapping Framework With Advanced FDR Control |
| [mbtools](https://gibbons-lab.github.io/mbtools) | Collection of R tools to analyze microbiome data |
| [MDiNE](https://academic.oup.com/bioinformatics/advance-article/doi/10.1093/bioinformatics/btz824/5614428) | MDiNE: a model to estimate differential co-occurrence networks in microbiome studies |
| [MDPbiome](https://academic.oup.com/bioinformatics/article/34/17/i838/5093255) | MDPbiome: microbiome engineering through prescriptive perturbations |
| [MedTest](https://academic.oup.com/bioinformatics/article/34/11/1875/4810437) | A Distance-Based Approach for Testing the Mediation Effect of the Human Microbiome |
| [MegaR](https://github.com/BioHPC/MegaR) | An Interactive R Package for Metagenomic Sample Classification and Disease Prediction using Microbiota and Machine Learning |
| [MelonnPan](https://github.com/biobakery/melonnpan) | Model-based Genomically Informed High-dimensional Predictor of Microbial Community Metabolic Profiles |
| [Metacoder](http://journals.plos.org/ploscompbiol/article?id=10.1371/journal.pcbi.1005404) | An R package for visualization and manipulation of community taxonomic diversity data |
| [metagenomeSeq](http://www.nature.com/nmeth/journal/v10/n12/full/nmeth.2658.html) | Differential abundance analysis for microbial marker-gene surveys |
| [MetaLonDA](https://github.com/aametwally/MetaLonDA) | METAgenomic LONgitudinal Differential Abundance method |
| [metamicrobiomeR](https://github.com/cran/metamicrobiomeR) | Analysis of Microbiome Relative Abundance Data using Zero Inflated Beta GAMLSS and Meta-Analysis Across Studies using Random Effects Model |
| [metaSPARSim](https://gitlab.com/sysbiobig/metasparsim) | An R tool for 16S rRNA-gene sequencing count data simulation |
| [microbiome R package](https://github.com/microbiome/microbiome) | Tools for microbiome analysis in R |
| [MicrobiomeDDA](https://academic.oup.com/bioinformatics/article/34/4/643/4470360) | An Omnibus Test for Differential Distribution Analysis of Microbiome Sequencing Data |
| [MicrobiomeExplor](https://doi.org/10.1093/bioinformatics/btaa838) | An R package for the analysis and visualization of microbial communities |
| [MicrobiomeHD](http://www.biorxiv.org/content/early/2017/05/08/134031) | A standardized database of human gut microbiome studies in health and disease *Case-Control* |
| [microbiomeMarker](https://github.com/yiluheihei/microbiomeMarker) | R package for microbiome biomarker discovery |
| [MicrobiomeR](https://microbiomer.vallenderlab.org/) | MicrobiomeR: An R Package for Simplified and Standardized Microbiome Analysis Workflows |
| [microbiomeutilities](https://microsud.github.io/microbiomeutilities/) | Extending and supporting package based on microbiome and phyloseq R package |
| [microbiotaPair](https://github.com/rusher321/microbiotaPair) | An R Package for Simplified Microbiome Analysis Workflows on Intervention Study |
| [MicrobiotaProcess](https://github.com/YuLab-SMU/MicrobiotaProcess) | MicrobiotaProcess: an R package for analysis, visualization and biomarker discovery of microbiome |
| [MicroBVS](https://bmcbioinformatics.biomedcentral.com/articles/10.1186/s12859-020-03640-0) | Dirichlet-tree multinomial regression models with Bayesian variable selection - an R package |
| [microDecon](https://github.com/donaldtmcknight/microDecon) | An R package for removing contamination from metabarcoding (e.g., microbiome) datasets post-sequencing |
| [MicroNiche](https://academic.oup.com/femsec/article-abstract/96/8/fiaa131/5863182?redirectedFrom=fulltext) | An R package for assessing microbial niche breadth and overlap from amplicon sequencing data |
| [microViz](https://david-barnett.github.io/microViz/) | An R package for for analysis and visualization of microbiome sequencing data |
| [miLineage](https://medschool.vanderbilt.edu/tang-lab/software/miLineage) | A General Framework for Association Analysis of Microbial Communities on a Taxonomic Tree |
| [MINT](https://bmcbioinformatics.biomedcentral.com/articles/10.1186/s12859-017-1553-8) | Multivariate INTegrative method |
| [mixDIABLO](http://mixomics.org/mixdiablo/) | Data Integration Analysis for Biomarker discovery using Latent variable approaches for ‘Omics studies |
| [mixMC](http://journals.plos.org/plosone/article?id=10.1371/journal.pone.0160169) | Multivariate Statistical Framework to Gain Insight into Microbial Communities |
| [MMinte](https://bmcbioinformatics.biomedcentral.com/articles/10.1186/s12859-016-1230-3) | Methodology for the large-scale assessment of microbial metabolic interactions (MMinte) from 16S rDNA data |
| [MTA](https://github.com/chanw0/MTA) | Microbial trend analysis (MTA) for common dynamic trend, group comparison and classification in longitudinal microbiome study |
| [NBZIMM](https://bmcbioinformatics.biomedcentral.com/articles/10.1186/s12859-020-03803-z) | Negative binomial and zero-inflated mixed models, with application to microbiome/metagenomics data analysis |
| [NetCoMi](https://academic.oup.com/bib/advance-article/doi/10.1093/bib/bbaa290/6017455) | Network construction and comparison for microbiome data in R |
| [NMIT](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC5696116/#!po=75.0000) | Microbial Interdependence Association Test--a Non-parametric Microbial Interdependence Test |
| [OMiSA](https://github.com/hk1785/OMiSA) | Optimal Microbiome-based Survival Analysis (OMiSA) |
| [pathostat](https://bioconductor.org/packages/release/bioc/html/PathoStat.html) | Statistical Microbiome Analysis on metagenomics results from sequencing data samples - [support deprecated](https://github.com/mani2012/PathoStat/issues/48) |
| [phylofactor](https://peerj.com/articles/2969/) | Phylogenetic factorization of compositional data |
| [phylogeo](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pubmed/25913208) | Geographic analysis and visualization of microbiome data |
